description: Maximo API to Retrieve Meter Data
title: METER

metertype.title: Meter Type
metertype.remarks: Maximo supports three types of meters: CONTINUOUS, GAUGE and CHARACTERISTIC.

description_longdescription.title: Details
description_longdescription.remarks: Use the Long Description dialog box to enter or view descriptions that are too large (more than 50 characters in length) for the Description field.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the meter group.The description can be up to 255 characters in length. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

domainid.title: Domain
domainid.remarks: Constraint defining what are valid values for this meter. A domain can be ALN, NUMERIC or from a value list.

measureunitid.title: Unit of Measure
measureunitid.remarks: Measurement unit associated with this meter.

metername.title: Meter
metername.remarks: Meter identifier, for example, HOURS or KILOMETERS

hasld.title: Has Long Description
hasld.remarks: Boolean flag to indicate if there is any long description for this record

readingtype.title: Reading Type
readingtype.remarks: Do readings for this meter default to an ACTUAL or DELTA reading type.
